column1: # Cross-distro package manifest, consumed by bin/pkg.
# TAB-separated. First line is the header naming the columns; the first
# column is the logical name used by callers, each remaining column is a
# package manager. Use "-" when a manager has no package for that tool.
# macOS packages stay in the Brewfile — this covers the Linux userlands.
#   apt  - all names confirmed installable on ubuntu:24.04 (container).
#   apk  - all names confirmed installable on alpine:3.23 w/ community repo.
#   pacman/dnf - best-known, not yet run against live repos; `pkg` narrates
#                any miss and is idempotent, so re-running after a fix is safe.
# Keep rows alphabetized by logical name.
